messages:
oliver: Hey team — customer on Dedicated eu-west is seeing their streaming tool_call args cut off mid-JSON when the client reconnects. Example payload cuts here: 
{
  "tool": "payment",
  "args": {
    "amount": 100,
    "currency": "USD",
    "metadata": {
      "order_id": "ord_9876..."
    }
  }
}
<stream ended>
Request id: req_abc123. Happens ~1-2% of streams, higher under load. Repro with our JS SDK (v2.4.1) + curl --http2 --no-buffer.

maria: Thanks — can you paste the curl command + any raw SSE fragments and the route used? Also which runtime/model? :eyes:

oliver: Route: POST /v1/streams?mode=tool_call, model=redwood-1.1-64k, Dedicated pool eu-west-1. Curl I used: 
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
  -H "X-Request-ID: req_abc123"
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream"
  --http2 --no-buffer
  --data-binary @payload.json
```
Raw SSE snippet captured (truncated):
```
data: {"type":"tool_call","name":"payment","args":{"amount":100,"currency":"USD","metadata":{"order_id":"ord_9876"}}}
data: {"type":"tool_call","name":"payment","args":{"amount":100,"currency":"USD","metadata":{"order_id":"ord_9876","notes":"large-meta-blob..."}`
```
You can see the second chunk ends mid-string.

maria: Hmm. Two quick hypotheses: 1) edge proxy or LB is splitting/silently resetting TCP/HTTP2 streams (we've seen this with certain keepalive settings). 2) client-side reconnect merges frames poorly and we end up with a partial JSON in the tool args. Can you attach the edge-proxy logs for req_abc123 and a tcpdump if possible? Also does the SDK apply any streaming buffering or reassembly? :thinking:

oliver: SDK v2.4.1 uses fetch + EventSource fallback on node; we've seen it re-open on ECONNRESET. I'll try to capture tcpdump and paste the minimal pcap events. Edge logs show an HTTP2 RST_STREAM around the time. Pasted header snippet: 
```
:method: POST
:authority: api.redwood.example
:scheme: https
:path: /v1/streams?mode=tool_call
x-request-id: req_abc123
content-type: application/json
transfer-encoding: chunked
```

maria: transfer-encoding: chunked + http2 can be a red flag if the proxy rewrites framing. Two immediate mitigation options to test: 1) Have the client base64-encode the tool args payload (so truncated streams are still syntactically valid until reassembled), 2) add a short keepalive/heartbeat inside the SSE stream so downstream proxies don't decide to close odd inactive streams. Can you try base64-encoding a failing payload and see if the server accepts it (we can decode on the tool handler)?

oliver: Will try base64 test. Also attaching the pcap excerpt (converted to hex): `...  17 03 03 ... RST_STREAM (0x1) ...` looks like RST from upstream LB. I'll repro with a local nginx proxy to mimic.

eng-runtime: Assigning to runtime team to investigate potential http2 fragment handling. Searching logs for req_abc123... found worker-runtime-3 handled it and emitted: 
`WARN runtime/streaming: incomplete tool args after reconnect for req=req_abc123, bytes_received=4096, expected_continuation=true`

ryan: I'm going to look at the reassembly path. Quick question: do we persist partial KV cache state when a stream reconnects? if not, reattach could lead to partial JSON being interpreted as final. Also please confirm whether the SDK sends a resume token on reconnect.

oliver: SDK doesn't send a resume token today; it simply reconnects and restarts the stream. The client observed a reconnect within ~200ms and sometimes the server receives the second fragment as a standalone event.

ryan: Ok. If reconnect restarts without a resume token, the safest server behavior is to treat a mid-toolcall fragment as incomplete and buffer until either EOS or timeout. We should add a defensive check in runtime: if a tool_call args JSON fragment is not valid JSON, do not attempt to parse/route tool invocation — return a 400 or request a retry. I'll open an internal PR with a strict JSON parse gate and logging: 
`if !is_complete_json(args_raw) { log.warn(...); send client event type=error, code=partial_args }`

maria: For the customer immediate workaround: ask them to implement client-side retry logic with idempotency (tool calls are idempotent where possible), or base64-encode args. Also lower TCP keepalive timeout on the LB to see if it reduces RST_STREAM. I've created ticket SUP-2026-912 and attached current traces + pcap. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Ticket SUP-2026-912 created and linked to thread req_abc123. Priority: P2. Assigned to eng-runtime/ryan.

oliver: Thanks — I'll send the customer the workaround steps and repro notes. Will follow up with base64 result within the hour. :thumbsup:
